entities.summary: Sava, a notable figure in the history of Serbia, associated with Serbian Principalities & Nemanjić Dynasty (1166–1331). Preceded by Serbian Orthodox Church and Early Serbian Principalities. Their legacy influenced Saint Sava establishes the autocephalous Serbian Orthodox Church and Dušan's Code.
